data.one_liner: A simple typewriter text animation wrapper for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a typewriter text animation wrapper with support for characters, words, and streams. It allows customizing the typing duration, repeat behavior, alignment, and listening to completion callbacks.
use_when: You want a typewriter effect for text displaying in your Flutter application.
You need to animate text appearance character by character or word by word.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based animations or non-text motion graphics.
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including iOS, Android, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Provides controllers for text values, multiple paragraphs, and streams.
Includes customizable speed, repeat settings, and completion callbacks.
weaknesses: Limited scope strictly to typewriter text animations.
